summary: ansible.builtin.tojson is the Jinja builtin filter that serializes an object to JSON and marks it safe for HTML.
questions: What is the difference between tojson and to_json?

answer_card.title: tojson filter
answer_card.answer_md: `tojson` is Jinja's builtin filter: it serializes an object to a JSON string and marks it safe to render in HTML.
